description:
Iterly is the ultimate companion app designed specifically for independent developers who want to take control of their app production lifecycle. 
Say goodbye to scattered notes and generic project management tools. Iterly brings order to your development chaos by combining task tracking with structured release planning.
Whether you are squashings bugs for a hotfix or mapping out a massive 2.0 overhaul, Iterly helps you visualize exactly what needs to be done to ship your next update with confidence.

KEY FEATURES:
* Release-Centric Organization: Group your tasks, features, and fixes by specific app version numbers so you always know what is dropping next.
* Focused Task Management: Create, prioritize, and check off items tailored specifically to software development workflows (Features, Bugs, Improvements).
* Intuitive Dashboard: Get a bird's-eye view of your entire app history, past releases, and current milestones.
* Built for Indie Devs: Clean, fast, and completely focused on the unique needs of single developers and small teams trying to ship high-quality apps efficiently.

Stop managing your app updates in spreadsheets. Download Iterly today and start iterating smarter!
whatsNew:
Your Activity widget just got smarter — pick exactly which projects show up, and watch your streak flame cool if you go a day without logging progress.

New
• Customize your large Activity widget to feature the projects you care about most, right from the widget's own settings.
• Your streak flame now cools gradually the longer an active streak goes unlogged — a subtle nudge to keep your momentum going.
• Prefer an ad-free experience? Remove Ads is now available as a simple one-time purchase.
• A new in-app tutorial walks you through adding and setting up Iterly widgets on your Home Screen.

Improved
• The small widget's layout is cleaner and easier to read at a glance.
• Project cards now show your available tasks count instead of the total, so you always know what's actually left to do.

Fixed
• Fixed an issue where deleting a project could behave unexpectedly.
promotionalText: Smarter Activity widgets, a cooling streak flame, and a new ad-free option — update Iterly today.
